messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync 0000NimbusEdge (hardware SI) wants a dual-marketplace launch (Azure Gov + GCP). They asked what we need for the security bundle: SOC2, pen-test report, firmware attestation, and a minimal manifest. Target kickoff is 6 weeks. Who owns what?

sam-security: I0000can own SOC2 + pen ingestion. Need to confirm pen scope (external network vs full device extraction) and whether they used a 3rd-party pen witness. @jon-eng do they have an HSM?

jon-eng: Yes, on-box HSM for signing FW blobs. We'll need vendor HSM attestation + key fingerprint + serial numbers, and the firmware hash chain (signed manifests). Also confirm pen testers had ability to extract bootloader, otherwise ask for explicit test steps.

maria-partnerships: The partner prefers a single artifact bundle (zip) with redactions. They asked if we can accept presigned S3 upload and escrow artifacts for marketplace review. Is that OK?

lee-ops: Presign S3 is OK. We have presign flow at s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024. Default retention 30 days; can extend to 90 days for reviewer windows. I'll spin a presign with 7-day expiry for initial upload.

ci-bot: Intake checklist created (MKP-4291): SOC2 summary (owner: sam-security), Pen-test report + scope (sam-security), Firmware attestation + hashes (jon-eng), Redaction manifest (tara-sis), Presign upload link (lee-ops).

sam-security: Couple of asks for the pen pack: scope doc, CVSS export for any critical/high findings, remediation evidence or formal risk acceptance. If pen is older than 12 months require re-test or compensating controls. Also ask for auditor statement if available.

tara-sis: I'll handle redaction guidance. Q: do we require an external auditor to sign off on redaction chain-of-custody, or is partner attestation OK?

sam-security: Auditor attestation preferred for SOC/pen where available. Partner-signed attestation is acceptable for firmware manifests/screenshots; we'll mark those as "limited assurance" in our intake.

lee-ops: Presign example for partner:
```
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024/nimbusedge-artifacts.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Please include checksum header: sha256:nimbus-edge-<hex>. Also include a small manifest.json listing files and file-level checksums.

maria-partnerships: OK owners + deadlines: sam-security - ingest SOC/pen by EOD Friday (1749999999), jon-eng - firmware attestation + hashes by next Tue (1750230000), lee-ops - presign link by EOD today, tara-sis - redaction template by Mon. I'll send partner instructions with the presign link and manifest template.

sam-security: Action: will validate pen scope on receipt and confirm if a 3rd-party witness is required. If witness required, request partner availability in next 2 weeks.

jon-eng: If HSM attestation required, request HSM vendor attestation PDF + signing key fingerprint. We'll prepare a verification runbook but need those artifacts to start.

maria-partnerships: Draft partner message: "Hi NimbusEdge team 0000We're ready to intake artifacts. Please upload a single zip to the presign link with: SOC2 summary, pen-test bundle (scope, report, evidence), firmware attestation + signed manifest, and manifest.json with checksums. If you need a witness window, include available dates. We'll send a redaction template."

tara-sis: Redaction notes I'll ask them to remove PII (usernames, IPs as necessary), replace tokens with <REDACTED_REASON>, and include a redaction log file mapping filename -> redacted items. Will post template here. :white_check_mark:

lee-ops: Presign link DM'd to partner and ACLs applied. Expiry 7 days; can reissue. Bucket path: s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024/nimbusedge-artifacts.zip.

maria-partnerships: Thanks all. If anything blocks pen evidence ingestion set channel priority to P0 and ping legal/security. I'll follow up with partner and confirm timelines. :pray:
